svg.title: zquota - no quota guesswork, exact reset times
svg.desc: A quota dial: forty usage blocks with sixty percent lit in teal and the 80% threshold marked in red, inside the five-hour window, where a dot travels round to the amber reset marker at the top.

text.tspan: Your Z.ai plan, usage bars and the exact reset time
for every rolling window. --watch keeps it live.
